cases.translation: Raskolnikov's face grew darker and darker.
cases.explain: Лицо is the grammatical subject of омрачалось (was darkening), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: я и дошел до последнего ___, да как стукнулся лбом.
cases.translation: I got all the way to the last post, and hit my forehead against it, so to speak.
cases.explain: The preposition до (up to) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: лицо его... как будто грустью подернулось, к ___ Раскольникова.
cases.translation: His face seemed to be veiled with sadness, to Raskolnikov's surprise.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case here.

cases.sentence: Вспомнил тут я и вашу ___, в журнальце-то.
cases.translation: I remembered your little article, in that magazine.
cases.explain: Статейку is the direct object of the transitive verb вспомнил (remembered), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Этот проклятый мещанинишка просидел у меня тогда за ___.
cases.translation: That wretched little tradesman sat there behind the partition at my place.
cases.explain: The preposition за (behind) indicating static location governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Вспомнил тут я вашу статейку, в ___-то, помните?
cases.translation: I remembered your little article, in that little journal, remember?
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location governs the prepositional case.
